items.title: 21.4 Halogenoalkanes ke reactions ki misalein (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the reactions of halogenoalkanes (PDF 82-84).

blocks.text: Hydroxide ion achha nucleophile bhi hai aur achha base bhi, is liye halogenoalkane halaat ke mutabiq substitution ya elimination products de sakta hai. Reactions urne wale products zaya hone se bachane ke liye reflux par zyada darja hararat par kiye jate hain. Bromoethane aabi sodium hydroxide se ethanol aur ethanol mein sodium hydroxide se ethene deta hai:

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wala bromoethane + NaOH, teer ke oopar 'aqueous' (aabi), se khuli banawat wala ethanol + NaBr.
blocks.caption: Substitution reaction: bromoethane aur aabi sodium hydroxide (kitab ke PDF safha 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wala bromoethane + NaOH, teer ke oopar 'alcohol', se khuli banawat wali ethene + HOH + NaBr.
blocks.caption: Elimination reaction: bromoethane aur alcohol mein sodium hydroxide (kitab ke PDF safha 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Elimination (ethanol mein): CH3CH2Br + NaOH -> CH2=CH2 + H2O + NaBr

blocks.text: Cyanide ion taqatwar nucleophile lekin kamzor base hai, is liye substitution deta hai: nitrile. Halogenoalkane ko ethanol mein potassium cyanide ke saath reflux par garam kiya jata hai. Bromoethane propanenitrile deta hai, jis mein aik carbon atom zyada hai: CH3CH2Br + KCN -> CH3CH2CN + KBr.

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wala bromoethane + K+ -C(teen bond)N, teer ke oopar 'alcohol', se khuli banawat wala propanenitrile, H3C-CH2-C(teen bond)N, + KBr.
blocks.caption: Bromoethane aur potassium cyanide (kitab ke PDF safha 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ammonia achha nucleophile hai aur ethanol mein pressure ke saath garam kiye gaye halogenoalkanes se react karti hai: C2H5Br + NH3 -> C2H5NH2 (ethylamine, ethanamine) + HBr. Miqdaron ko ehtiyat se qabu kar ke mukhtalif amines hasil kiye ja sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Ammonia, N par lone pair, aur N se C2H5-Br ke carbon ki taraf mura teer; C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mura teer. Natija ethylamine, H2N-C2H5, + HBr (hydrogen bromide).
blocks.caption: Ammonia aur bromoethane (kitab ke PDF safha 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Banne wala amine khud nucleophile hai aur ammonia se muqabla karta hai, is liye mazeed substitution se N-ethylethanamine, (C2H5)2NH, phir N,N-diethylethanamine, (C2H5)3N, bante hain.

blocks.alt: Ethanamine (N par C2H5, do H aur lone pair) se C2H5-Br ke carbon ki taraf aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mure teer; natija N-ethylethanamine + HBr.
blocks.caption: Ethanamine aur bromoethane (kitab ke PDF safha 83 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: N-ethylethanamine (N par do C2H5, aik H aur lone pair) se C2H5-Br ke carbon ki taraf aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mure teer; natija N,N-diethylethanamine + HBr.
blocks.caption: N-ethylethanamine aur bromoethane (kitab ke PDF safha 83 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Bromoethane ki bohat zyada miqdar se aakhri product quaternary ammonium namak, tetraethylammonium bromide, (C2H5)4N+ Br-, hai.

blocks.alt: N,N-diethylethanamine (N par teen C2H5 aur lone pair) se C2H5-Br ke carbon ki taraf aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mure teer; natija quaternary namak (salt): chaar C2H5 wala N, chaukor bracket mein musbat charge ke saath, aur bracket ke bahar Br-.
blocks.caption: N,N-diethylethanamine aur bromoethane (kitab ke PDF safha 83 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har qadam mein N ka lone pair C2H5-Br ke carbon par hamla karta hai aur Br nikal jata hai. Aakhri product quaternary ammonium namak hai: musbat ion [(C2H5)4N]+ bracket ke andar aur Br- bracket ke bahar. Kitab ne Br- ko bhi musbat bracket ke andar chhapa hai aur naam 'N,N,N-triethylethanaminebromide' likha hai; sahi naam N,N,N-triethylethanaminium bromide (yani tetraethylammonium bromide) hai.
IV. Aabi silver nitrate ke saath

Reaction paani aur ethanol ke mixture mein kiya jata hai; ethanol halogenoalkane ko ghulne mein madad deta hai. Paani nucleophile ka kaam kar ke halogen ki jagah leta hai: CH3CH2X + H2O -> CH3CH2OH + H+ + X-. Nikalne wala halide ion phir silver nitrate se react kar ke precipitate deta hai jis ka rang batata hai ke kaun sa halogen tha.

blocks.alt: Aabi ethanol wale silver nitrate ki teen test tubes: chloroalkane se AgCl ka safaid (white) precipitate bohat dheere, bromoalkane se AgBr ka cream yellow precipitate tez, aur iodoalkane se AgI ka bright yellow precipitate sab se tez. Har tube ke neeche Ag+ + Cl- -> AgCl, Ag+ + Br- -> AgBr, Ag+ + I- -> AgI.
blocks.caption: Silver nitrate se halogen ki pehchan (is reaction ke liye asal khaaka, kitab ki figure nahi).
blocks.long_description: Precipitate ka rang halogen batata hai, aur jis raftaar se woh nazar aata hai woh halogenoalkane ki reactivity dikhati hai: iodoalkane sab se jaldi, bromoalkane us ke baad, aur chloroalkane bohat dheere.

blocks.prompt: Halogenoalkanes ko organic compounds ki bohat reactive qism kyun samjha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: C-X bond polar hai, is liye carbon electrophilic aur nucleophiles ka nishana hai; halide ion achha leaving group hai; aur C-Cl, C-Br aur C-I bonds C-H se kamzor hain. Bases HX hata kar alkenes bhi de sakte hain.
CH3COOC2H5 (ethyl ethanoate) + NaBr: ethanoate ion nucleophile ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethane ko ethanol aur ethene mein kaise badlenge?
blocks.explanation: Roshni mein ethane + Cl2 se chloroethane. Chloroethane ko aabi NaOH ke saath garam karne se ethanol; ethanol mein NaOH ke saath garam karne se ethene.

blocks.prompt: 1-bromopropane ka KCN se reaction batayein. Yeh substitution hai ya elimination? Product ka naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: CH3CH2CH2Br + KCN -> CH3CH2CH2CN + KBr (ethanol mein, reflux). Yeh nucleophilic substitution hai; product butanenitrile hai.

items: NaOH(aq): alcohol (substitution); ethanol mein NaOH: alkene (elimination).
Ethanol mein KCN: aik zyada C wala nitrile; NH3: amines, aakhir mein quaternary namak.
AgNO3(aq, ethanol): AgCl safaid, AgBr cream, AgI peela; kamzor C-X ke liye tez.
